rooms.name: Below the backroom
rooms.desc:
You have entered a dark room where a feeling of dread quickly 
overcomes you.  You feel the hair on your neck rise, and start to
think that maybe you should go back where you were.

rooms.name: Dark and scary hall
rooms.desc:
This hallway runs east and west, with doorways to the north and
south.  Your light source illuminates nicks and scratches linig the
walls, made from some unknown sharp object (maybe claws).

rooms.name: Dark and scary hall
rooms.desc:
This hallway runs east and west, with doorways to the north and
south.  Your light source illuminates nicks and scratches linig the
walls, made from some unknown sharp object (maybe claws).

rooms.name: The wight room with Black Curtiss
rooms.desc:
You hear a faint playing of music eminating from the walls but
it is hard to figure out where it is from.

rooms.name: Corpse storage
rooms.desc:
This room is a little colder than the other rooms which you have
been travelling through, a perfect room for preserving corpses.  It
doesn't seem to have been too fruitful, although the corpses are.

rooms.name: Corpse storage
rooms.desc:
This room is a little colder than the other rooms which you have
been travelling through, a perfect room for preserving corpses.  It
doesn't seem to have been too fruitful, although the corpses are.

rooms.name: The salt stop
rooms.desc:
Just being in this room makes you thirsty, salt on all the walls,
on the floor, and now in your hair.

rooms.name: The cannery
rooms.desc:
This is a very strange, all of the walls are lined with pepper. It
must be a natural resource in this area.

24777.name: A salty corpse
24777.long: A well-salted corpse stands here.  He looks well preserved.
24777.desc:
Either he has been in the undead navy or else someone got him good 
with a salt shaker.

24778.name: A pepped up corpse
24778.long: A corpse stands here, looking awfully pepped up for a dead person.
24778.desc: It appears to have small black flecks all over it.

24779.name: A corpse
24779.long: A corpse is here, apparently stored against future need.
24779.desc: It is a dead person, not much of a looker.

24780.name: The wight
24780.long: A wight steps forward to eat you.  You hope this is not the draining kind.
24780.desc:
It is a foul looking apparition, with long, filthy claws that are ready 
to grab hold of you for a snacking opportunity.

24781.name: Black Curtiss
24781.long: Black Curtiss is standing here, thinking of Cream.
24781.desc: He appears to have quite a habit of dressing in black.

24783.name: The Salter
24783.long: The Salter stands here, salting some corpses.
24783.desc: He seems happy to have his job.  He just likes to shake it.

sounds.near: The Salter shakes some salt on a corpse.

24784.name: Dr. Pepper
24784.long: Doctor Pepper is here, pepping up some down-looking corpses.
24784.desc:
He seems awfully healthy for a corpse.  Maybe he gets a lot of prune 
juice or something.

sounds.near: Dr. Pepper shakes some pepper and sneezes loudly.

24761.name: some black curtains
24761.long: A disused set of black curtains lies in a heap on the floor.

24771.name: a shield fashioned of human skin
24771.long: A small leather-looking shield lies face-down on the floor.

24772.name: a rotting pair of pants
24772.long: You notice a pile of rotting fabric on the floor

24774.name: a spice cabinet
24774.long: A finely crafted cabinet has been left behind by its last owner

24775.name: a flask of prune juice
24775.long: A small flask has been left here.
